quote: By-reference foreach loops may now visit previously skipped elements after array compaction.
reason: Depends on which elements are deleted and when the array is compacted at run time; the notes only say loops "may" visit other elements, so the fixture claims nothing and records the keys 7.4-8.5 visit (the same on all of them).

quote: ??/empty() on a magic property no longer call __get() when __isset() has materialized the property by writing into the property table.
reason: Whether __isset() writes the property is decided inside the magic method at run time; the fixtures show ?? and empty() calling __get() after __isset() wrote the property on every runtime 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 is documented only).

quote: It is no longer possible to clone variant objects because the cloning behavior was ill-defined.
reason: COM is a Windows-only extension and is not loaded in any of the runtimes.

quote: The callback registered with CURLOPT_READFUNCTION now throws a ValueError when returning an integer other than 0, CURL_READFUNC_ABORT or CURL_READFUNC_PAUSE.
reason: Depends on the integer a callback returns during a transfer; a probe with a file:// upload whose callback returns 5 did not finish on 8.1+ in php-wasm, so no deterministic fixture is possible, and the callback cannot be told apart from a correct one.

quote: Properties previously documented as @readonly (e.g. DOMNode::$nodeType, DOMDocument::$xmlEncoding, DOMEntity::$actualEncoding, DOMEntity::$encoding, DOMEntity::$version) are now declared with asymmetric visibility (public private(set)).
reason: Writing these properties already throws Error on every runtime 7.4-8.5 (the fixture shows class Error everywhere; the message changed from "Cannot write property" to "Cannot write read-only property" in 8.1 and "Cannot modify readonly property" in 8.4); 8.6 changes only the message, so code that runs today is not affected.

quote: Array access on Dom\DtdNamedNodeMap objects now returns null for negative integer indexes instead of returning the first node.
reason: Dom\DtdNamedNodeMap exists only from 8.4 and the index is a run-time value; a fixture cannot show anything on 7.4-8.3, and a negative literal index on a DTD map is not something plugin code can be told to contain.

quote: Array access on Dom\DtdNamedNodeMap objects now raises a ValueError when the integer index is greater than INT_MAX instead of overflowing to a smaller index.
reason: Depends on an index value greater than INT_MAX at run time on a class that exists only from 8.4; nothing in the source distinguishes it.

quote: ftp_nb_fget(), ftp_nb_fput(), ftp_nb_get() and ftp_nb_put() now throw an Error when the connection is already transferring, instead of emitting a warning and returning false.
reason: The ftp extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: imagesetstyle(), imagefilter() and imagecrop() filter the types / values of their array arguments and raise a TypeError / ValueError accordingly.
reason: The element types of the array are run-time values; the fixture shows imagesetstyle() accepting a non-numeric string element silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only; the notes do not list which values imagefilter() and imagecrop() reject).

quote: imageaffinematrixget() now enforces the documented array|float type for the $options parameter, including the corresponding weak and strict typing behavior.
reason: The $options value is a run-time value; the fixture shows a non-numeric string accepted silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only, as a TypeError under weak typing).

quote: gmp_fact() now throws a ValueError if $num does not fit into an unsigned long.
reason: The gmp extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: gmp_pow(), gmp_binomial(), gmp_root() and gmp_rootrem() now throw a ValueError if their second argument does not fit into an unsigned long.
reason: The gmp extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: The shift (<<, >>) and exponentiation (**) operators on GMP objects now throw a ValueError when GMP right operands are outside the unsigned long range, instead of silently truncating them.
reason: The gmp extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: GMP integer string parsing now throws a ValueError for strings containing NUL bytes, instead of silently truncating them.
reason: The gmp extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: gmp_powm() modulo-by-zero now raises a DivisionByZeroError whose message includes the function name and argument index ($modulus).
reason: The gmp extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: Passing a non-stringable object as a time zone to Intl APIs that accept time zone objects or strings now raises a TypeError instead of an Error.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: IntlIterator::current() now returns null when called before the iterator is positioned, or after the iterator becomes invalid, instead of exposing an undefined value.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: IntlBreakIterator::getLocale() now raises a ValueError when the type is neither Locale::ACTUAL_LOCALE nor Locale::VALID_LOCALE instead of returning false.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: MessageFormatter::parse() and parseMessage() now return PHP_INT_MIN as int, rather than float, on 64-bit platforms when parsing integer values.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: The $type parameter of IntlBreakIterator::getPartsIterator() has been changed from string to int to match the underlying implementation.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: UConverter::transcode() now rejects from_subst and to_subst option values longer than 127 bytes instead of silently truncating the length before passing it to ICU.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: ResourceBundle::get() and resourcebundle_get() now report fallback-disabled resource lookups with "without fallback to <locale>" instead of the malformed "without fallback from to <locale>".
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: IntlDateFormatter::parse()/datefmt_parse() and IntlDateFormatter::localtime()/datefmt_localtime() now raise a TypeError when the offset argument is not of type int instead of silently converting the value.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: Collator::sort(), collator_sort(), Collator::asort(), and collator_asort() now report UTF-8/UTF-16 conversion failures during comparison through the intl error mechanism and return false.
reason: The intl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: Unicode data tables have been updated to Unicode 18.0
reason: Changes character data used on run-time strings; which characters a plugin processes cannot be seen in the source, and no runtime has Unicode 18 tables to compare with.

quote: pcntl_alarm() now raises a ValueError if the seconds argument is lower than zero or greater than the platform's UINT_MAX.
reason: The pcntl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: pcntl_exec() now raises a ValueError if the $args argument is not a list array.
reason: The pcntl extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: preg_grep() now returns false instead of a partial array when a PCRE execution error occurs (e.g. malformed UTF-8 input with the /u modifier).
reason: Depends on the subject strings at run time; the fixture shows preg_grep() returning the partial array for malformed UTF-8 with /u on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: pg_fetch_object() now reports the ValueError for a non-empty $constructor_args on a class without a constructor on the $constructor_args argument instead of $class.
reason: The pgsql extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: Phar::mungServer() now raises a ValueError when an invalid argument value is passed instead of being silently ignored.
reason: The fixture shows an unknown name ignored silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only); Phar::mungServer() is for phar stubs, not plugin or theme code, so no rule was written.

quote: Phar::addEmptyDir() now rejects "/.phar" paths in addition to ".phar" paths, and raises the same BadMethodCallException for attempts to create the reserved magic ".phar" directory through that form.
reason: The runtime contradicts the notes: PharData::addEmptyDir("/.phar") already throws BadMethodCallException on 8.4 and 8.5 (it works on 7.4-8.3), so the fixture claims breaks_in 8.4; the path is a run-time value in practice and building a Phar is not plugin code.

quote: Phar::addEmptyDir() now treats non-magic names that merely share the ".phar" prefix as ordinary directories.
reason: A relaxation that the runtime places earlier than the notes: ".pharx" is rejected on 7.4-8.3 and already created on 8.4 and 8.5 (fixture changed_in 8.4); code that runs today is not harmed.

quote: Files are only automatically interpreted as Phar archives when included if ".phar" occurs as an extension in the filename component of their paths.
reason: Whether an included path has ".phar" in a directory name is a run-time value; the fixture shows a plain PHP file inside a "*.phar" directory included as a plain file on every runtime 7.4-8.5, so only real archives under such names are affected, which the source does not show.

quote: Setting session.cookie_path, session.cookie_domain, or session.cache_limiter to a value containing NUL bytes now emits a warning and leaves the setting unchanged.
reason: The value is a run-time string; the fixture shows ini_set() storing a session.cookie_path with a NUL byte on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6: warning and unchanged setting, documented only).

quote: A ValueError is thrown if $name is a string containing NUL bytes in session_module_name().
reason: The name is a run-time value; the fixture shows session_module_name() accepting "files\0x" without a diagnostic on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: session_encode() now returns an empty string instead of false for empty sessions.
reason: Whether the session is empty is a run-time state; the fixture shows session_encode() returning false for an empty session on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: When session.lazy_write is enabled and a session handler implements SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface, sessions that were read as empty and remain empty at write time will now trigger updateTimestamp() instead of write().
reason: Depends on session contents at run time; the fixture shows write() being called for a session read and written empty under lazy_write on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6: updateTimestamp(), documented only).

quote: The defaults of three session INI settings have changed to provide secure behavior out of the box:
reason: Changed INI defaults (session.use_strict_mode, session.cookie_httponly, session.cookie_samesite), not source code.

quote: SessionHandler::validateId() has been added and delegates to the configured save handler.
reason: New rule Php86BicSessionValidateId reports a validateId() without return type in a class that extends SessionHandler directly (not one that also implements SessionUpdateTimestampHandlerInterface, deprecated since 8.1); the fixtures declare such classes without diagnostics on 7.4-8.5, deprecated_in 8.6 documented only; the open()/parent::open() warning in the same bullet is run-time and not reported.

quote: shmop_open() now raises a ValueError when the $key argument is outside the platform's key_t range instead of passing a truncated key to the operating system.
reason: The shmop extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: SimpleXMLElement::__construct() now raises a ValueError when the $data argument contains NUL bytes, matching simplexml_load_file().
reason: The data is a run-time string; the fixture shows new SimpleXMLElement($path . "\0junk", 0, true) loading the truncated path on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: The "classmap" option of SoapClient and SoapServer now rejects arrays containing integer keys.
reason: New rule Php86BicSoapClassmap reports literal classmaps with string and integer keys (SoapClient, SoapServer) and a non-array literal classmap (SoapClient); the runtimes accepted those on 7.4-8.5 but already rejected integer-only classmaps from 8.2, which are therefore not reported as an 8.6 change.

quote: WSDL/XML Schema parsing now rejects out-of-range integer values for occurrence constraints and integer restriction facets.
reason: Depends on the content of WSDL documents read at run time, not on the PHP source.

quote: SOAP encoding errors now report the affected type or failing operation in the error message instead of the generic "Encoding: Violation of encoding rules" message.
reason: Only the text of SOAP encoding error messages changes; code that compares the message cannot be told apart from code that does not.

quote: socket_set_option() with SO_ATTACH_REUSEPORT_CBPF now requires an int $value and a $level of SOL_SOCKET.
reason: The sockets extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: socket_set_option() with SO_ATTACH_REUSEPORT_CBPF and a $value of 0 now detaches the reuseport filter through SO_DETACH_REUSEPORT_BPF.
reason: The sockets extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: The password-hashing functions sodium_crypto_pwhash(), sodium_crypto_pwhash_str(), sodium_crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256() and sodium_crypto_pwhash_scryptsalsa208sha256_str() now throw ValueError instead of SodiumException when an argument is out of range, such as an opslimit or memlimit below the documented minimum.
reason: The sodium extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: SplObjectStorage::getHash() implementations may no longer mutate any SplObjectStorage instance.
reason: What getHash() does is decided when it runs; the fixture shows a getHash() that adds to another SplObjectStorage working on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: SplFileObject::next() now advances the stream when no prior current() call has cached a line.
reason: Depends on the order of calls on one object at run time; the fixture shows current() after next() without a prior current() returning the first line on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: SplFileObject::fgets() no longer caches the returned line for subsequent current() calls.
reason: Depends on the order of calls on one object at run time; the fixture shows current() returning the line fgets() just returned on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: SplFileObject::next() past EOF no longer increments key() without bound.
reason: Depends on how often next() is called past the end at run time; the fixture shows key() reaching 6 for a two-line file on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: DirectoryIterator::key() now returns int|string, and DirectoryIterator::current() returns string|SplFileInfo|static.
reason: A narrower declared return type; the runtimes report the tentative return type "mixed" for both methods on 8.1-8.5, and the notes do not say what happens to subclasses that override them, so nothing can be claimed for source code.

quote: array_intersect() with at least two arrays now converts values to strings while scanning its inputs instead of during sort comparisons.
reason: Depends on the values and their __toString() at run time; the notes say the conversions "can change" without stating a result, so the fixture claims nothing and records 2 kept values and 16 __toString() calls on 7.4-8.5.

quote: Form feed (\f) is now added to the default trimmed characters of trim(), rtrim() and ltrim().
reason: Whether a string has form feeds at its ends is a run-time value and one-argument trim() calls are everywhere; the fixture shows "\f" kept on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: array_filter() now raises a ValueError when an invalid $mode argument value is passed.
reason: New rule Php86BicInvalidModes reports a literal $mode outside 0, 1, 2; the fixture shows mode 3 accepted silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only); modes from variables are not reported.

quote: array_change_key_case() now raises a ValueError when an invalid $case argument value is passed.
reason: Php86BicInvalidModes reports a literal $case other than CASE_LOWER/CASE_UPPER; the fixture shows 2 accepted silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: getenv() and putenv() now raise a ValueError when the first argument contains NUL bytes.
reason: The name is a run-time string; the fixtures show getenv() and putenv() accepting NUL bytes silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: dl() now raises a ValueError when the $extension_filename argument contains NUL bytes.
reason: The file name is a run-time string, and dl() does run in the CLI SAPI that WP-CLI uses, so it is not out of scope; the fixture shows dl() cutting the name at the NUL byte (a warning, then false) on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: openlog() now raises a ValueError when the $prefix argument contains NUL bytes.
reason: The prefix is a run-time string; the fixture shows openlog() accepting a NUL byte on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: parse_str() now raises a ValueError when the $string argument contains NUL bytes.
reason: The query string is usually request data; the fixture shows parse_str() stopping silently at the NUL byte on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: setlocale() now raises a ValueError when a locale name contains NUL bytes, instead of silently truncating it.
reason: New rule Php86BicSetlocaleArrays reports array literals after $locales and extra arguments after an array $locales (accepted silently on 7.4-8.5 per the fixtures; breaks_in 8.6 documented only); the NUL-byte part depends on run-time strings and has the runtime fixture only.

quote: linkinfo() now raises a ValueError when the $path argument is empty.
reason: The path is a run-time value; the fixture shows linkinfo("") warning and returning -1 on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: pathinfo() now raises a ValueError when an invalid $flags argument value is passed.
reason: The notes do not say whether combined PATHINFO_* flags count as invalid, so no rule; the fixture shows flags 32 returning "" silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: scandir() now raises a ValueError when an invalid $sorting_order argument value is passed.
reason: Php86BicInvalidModes reports a literal $sorting_order outside 0, 1, 2; the fixture shows 3 accepted silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: number_format() now raises a ValueError when $decimals is outside the integer range instead of silently clamping very large positive values.
reason: Depends on a run-time $decimals beyond the C int range; a probe with 2147483648 decimals returned "2" on 7.4 and 8.0 but exhausted memory on 8.1+, so no deterministic fixture is possible.

quote: sleep() now raises a ValueError when $seconds is greater than the platform limit (UINT_MAX seconds, or UINT_MAX / 1000 seconds on Windows) instead of allowing the value to overflow.
reason: The duration is a run-time value; the fixture shows sleep(4294967296) overflowing to 0 and returning int(0) at once on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only), so no fixture actually sleeps.

quote: usleep() now raises a ValueError when $microseconds is greater than UINT_MAX instead of allowing the value to overflow.
reason: The duration is a run-time value; the fixture shows usleep(4294967297) returning silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: proc_open() now raises a ValueError when the $cwd argument contains NUL bytes.
reason: The $cwd is a run-time value, and fixtures may not start processes, so it cannot be demonstrated here.

quote: base_convert(), bindec(), hexdec() and octdec() now raise a notice when they cannot precisely convert the given number.
reason: Depends on the input number at run time; 8.6 adds only an E_NOTICE, which changes neither the result nor whether code runs, so the fixture claims nothing and shows a float on 7.4-8.5.

quote: The following functions now raise a ValueError when the $filename argument contains NUL bytes:
reason: File names are run-time values; the fixtures show file_exists() and filesize() returning without an exception for a name with a NUL byte on 7.4-8.5 (7.4 warns, 8.0+ return false; breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: unpack() now reads a "<" or ">" immediately following a format code as an endianness modifier rather than as the first character of the element name.
reason: New rule Php86BicUnpackEndianness reads literal unpack() formats; the fixtures show the keys "<value", ">size" and ">name" on 7.4-8.5 (changed_in 8.6, and breaks_in 8.6 for "C>", documented only); the notes do not list which other codes reject a modifier.

quote: shm_attach() now raises a ValueError when the $key argument is outside the platform's key_t range instead of passing a truncated key to the operating system.
reason: The sysvshm extension is not loaded in any of the runtimes (7.4-8.5), so no claim can be verified.

quote: __construct(), parse(), and with*() of Uri\WhatWg\Url, and Uri\WhatWg\UrlBuilder::build() now report validation errors in the order in which they are detected.
reason: Only the order of reported validation errors of the uri extension (8.5+) changes, decided by the URL at run time; the extension does not exist before 8.5, so no fixture can run on 7.4-8.4.

quote: Uri\WhatWg\Url::__construct() now sets $softErrors to an empty array when URL processing throws an exception, instead of preserving its value.
reason: Depends on a URL failing at run time in the uri extension (8.5+); the source does not show it and no fixture can run on 7.4-8.4.

quote: ZipArchive::extractTo now raises a TypeError for the files argument if one or more of the entries is not a string.
reason: The entry list is usually built at run time; the fixture shows an int entry accepted silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: ZipArchive::addGlob() and ZipArchive::addPattern() now raise a TypeError when the "remove_all_path" option is not of type bool, or when the "comp_method", "comp_flags", or "enc_method" options are not of type int (numeric strings are coerced), instead of emitting a warning.
reason: New rule Php86BicZipGlobOptions reports literal option values of the wrong type; the fixtures show 7.4 silent and 8.0-8.5 warning "must be of type bool, int given" and going on (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: Serializing or unserializing a ZipArchive now throws an Exception.
reason: Whether a serialized value holds a ZipArchive is a run-time type; the fixture shows serialize(new ZipArchive) working on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).

quote: deflate_init() now raises a TypeError when the value for option "level", "memory", "window", or "strategy" is not of type int.
reason: Option values are usually run-time values; the fixture shows deflate_init() accepting level "fast" silently on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only); literal non-int options are implausible in plugin code, so no rule.

quote: inflate_init() now raises a TypeError when the value for option "window" is not of type int.
reason: The fixture shows inflate_init() accepting window "15abc" without a diagnostic on 7.4-8.5 (breaks_in 8.6 documented only).
